summary:
# NOTES: *Olga Romanoff* by George Griffith (1897, Simpkin Marshall; illustrated by Fred T. Jane; dedicated to Hiram Stevens Maxim)

Single novel (no separate books). Front matter: frontispiece "Evil in such a shape might be something more than good" (p.176); epigraph from p.368 on snow/ice and fire-storm; 16 illustrations; CONTENTS: Prologue + ch. I–XXXII + Epilogue. Back matter: ads for *The Angel of the Revolution* (Griffith), *A Heroine of the Slums*, *The Great War in England in 1897* (Le Queux), *The Captain of the Mary Rose* (Laird Clowes). Transcriber notes ignored.

## PROLOGUE: The Prophecy of Natas
- Written by Israel di Murska, "Natas, Master of the Terror," to Children of Deliverance in Aeria, 25th year of Peace (=1930). Read every fifth year at Festival of Deliverance (8 Dec, anniversary of Victory; footnote: 8 Dec 1904 defeat of Franco-Slavonian League besieging London under Alexander Romanoff).
- Natas (Jew) created "the Terror"; Brotherhood of Freedom = Terrorists. Richard Arnold (Englishman) built first bird-like aircraft 1903, aerial fleet. Alan Tremayne led Anglo-Saxon league. Natasha (Natas's daughter, "Angel of the Revolution") pleaded to spare remnant. Russians slain; Tyrant and princes exiled to Siberia.
- War abolished; navies sunk; Aerians hold command of air = world command; prophecy: at 25th Festival, return sceptre to descendants of former rulers; "flaming sword" sign; messenger of Fate from stars, "flaming fire," breath as pestilence; survivors to be "chosen few" of fifth generation.

## CH I. The Surrender of the World-Throne
- 8 Dec 2030, St Paul's Cathedral London. Supreme Council (President + 12) abdicates. President = Alan Arnold (descendant of Tremayne, Arnold, Natasha); speech: keeps air-empire; any attempt to challenge = war.
- Golden Age described.

## CH II. A Crownless King
- Same night, Hampstead octagonal turret. Paul Romanoff (old, dying; son of Vladimir; great-grandson of Alexander) and Olga Romanoff (~16–17, dark imperious beauty, violet/black eyes). Paul takes death-draught (two vials, turn red); revives briefly.
- Serge Nicholaivitch (22, blond, tall; descendant of Nicholas via Dagmar of Denmark) arrives; kneels. Oath at ikon: ashes to Peter-Paul Fortress, then marriage at Uspènski Sobōr, Moscow.
- Secret compartment: Imperial crown of Russia (stolen in Terror). Paul's history: Olga + Serge the only surviving Romanoff heirs; Olga's grandmother line Prince Ingeborg (Denmark). Vladimir Romanoff killed in Norway forest (air-ship built secretly, 7 associates; traitor deserted; Terrorist ship destroyed all, blackened waste).
- Paul's speech: democracy will rot world; aim: Aeria. Dies trying to crown himself; crown falls. Olga weeps on body.

## CH III. Tsarina Olga
- Cremation at Highgate, 3 days later; registered as "Paul Ivanitch"; grandchildren Serge & Olga Ivanitch. Serge passed as her brother.
- Two wills: public and secret. Secret will: 400 descendant contacts; weapons; Vladimir's air-ship/submarine plans; direct conversion of coal solar energy to electricity; explosives formulae; hidden strip of parchment (the secret slip).
- Olga, wearing crown, declares herself Tsarina; Serge kneels, swears. She crowns him "Tsar."
- Olga tricks Serge (kiss for 20 min solitude) to read slip.

## CH IV. A Son of the Gods
- Train from London (Continental Station) to St Petersburg; Eastern express route to Pekin. Channel Bridge Dover–Calais 200 ft high. Train speed ~150–200 mph; passes Königsberg (split), Berlin, Moscow.
- Aerians Alan Arnoldson (son of President; 20s, dark-blue eyes) and Alexis Masarov (descendant of Alexis Mazanoff) met with Alderman Heatherstone. Golden wings insignia on band.
- Olga flirts; Alan: Aerians tell truth; cites "The Coming Race" (Lytton); Vril-force realized; can kill by thought. Serge jealous.

## CH V. A Vision from the Clouds
- Königsberg (9 hrs from London, ~7pm). Berlin: Olga persuades Serge to postpone wedding (plan).
- Night, air-ship (Ithuriel, ~200 ft hull, 10 guns, wings) swoops to train; Alan invites Olga on trip next day from St Petersburg. "Like gods" line; Olga inwardly vows he'll be her slave.

## CH VI. Deed and Dream
- Olga's night: spirit furnace; mixes poison: colourless fluid (sleep/will-killing) and blue "Elixir of Death" (fluid; soul-enslaving). Slip's calculations. Mirror, pale orange flame, sees her soul.
- Vision: air-ship over slaughter; then vision of Aeria (valley, lake, marble city, golden dome with silver winged woman). Alan: "That was your first and last glimpse of heaven. Now comes the judgment!" Visions of world's end: fire globe, dying earth.
- Flasks on chain round neck. Serge flatters; Olga dreams empire; plans seduction of Alan.
- Footnote about Borgias/poison.

## CH VII. The Spell of Circe
- Breakfast; sleigh race (Olga w/ Alan won by a head). Visit Peter-Paul fortress cell where Natas imprisoned 1881; plate. Olga angers ("He would have killed him").
- Skating: Alan says Aeria's ice pumped; Olga: "Simply because I have seen them!" describes Aeria. Plan to drug crew.
- Supper with Alan & Alexis; Olga drugs punch (blue drops). Serge hypnotised ("I am your slave").
- Next morning, Ithuriel lands in hotel garden; Olga & Serge board.

## CH VIII. The New Terror
- Ithuriel vanished 5 years earlier (winter 2030–1). Bodies of 8 crew found Norwegian snowdrift.
- President proclamation. 1st May 2036? (Rather: sea terror). "Disappearance of Three Transports": Massilia, Ceres, Astræa (The European Review). Submarines lost; Sirius found wrecked W of Ireland. New Terror; Aerians 250 vessels; Sultan Khalid the Magnificent (34) of Moslem Empire preparing armies.
- 1 May 2036: Olga's letter dropped from sky to Alan Arnold: "They have served my turn..." Alan and Alexis on island SP Pacific.

## CH IX. The Flight of the "Revenge"
- Ithuriel renamed Revenge. Pursuit by Ariel and Ithuriel (Aerians) through night; Boris Lossenski (Olga's gunner, made Prince) and Levin Ostroff (also rewarded). Aerian pursuers destroyed; Revenge sails to Antarctica (Mount Erebus); thirty Russian ships emerge; Aerians destroy 20; Russians flee; Olga screams with rage.
- Council in Aeria; Revenge's crew identifies Romanoff.

## CH X. Strange Tidings to Aeria
- Alan's letter (from Narwhal, submarine, Kerguelen plan). Council restores Alan & Alexis as commanders.
- Alma Tremayne (≈20; grey eyes, brown hair; descendant of Tremayne via Cyril) on terrace; Isma Arnold (Alan's sister) visits in swan boat "Cygna".

## CH XI. The Snake in Eden
- Alma & Isma talk. Isma: "Mars" referenced (Vassilis's communication). Alma hates Olga. Isma: Alan will return better man. Family council.

## CH XII. The Battle of Kerguelen
- Kerguelen Island station (Christmas Harbour), commander Max Ernstein (cachalot sub); Admiral Edward Forrest (Ariel). Narwhal rams Russian subs by needle. Russian attack by Michael Lossenski; Ariel + batteries repel. Narwhal torpedoes Russian fleet.

## CH XIII. The Syren's Stronghold
- Alan's report: Mount Terror in Antarctica; Russian explorer Kishenov; Louis Khemski; subterranean lake. Alexis plan: Narwhal blocks tunnel with torpedoes. Crew led by George Cosmo (chief engineer).

## CH XIV. From the Sea to the Air
- Narwhal succeeds, returns to Christmas Harbour. Council reply: Alan & Alexis command Ithuriel; 100 air-ships build. Isma's letter with photographs; Alma's photo kept by Alan. Isma gives Alexis letter.

## CH XV. Olga in Council
- Olga furious at Michael; sends him away. Lossenski (Orloff) advises alliance with Sultan Khalid. Mount Terror tunnel blocked. Council of War (12 members). Plan: Lossenski to Sultan; Olga follows.

## CH XVI. Khalid the Magnificent
- 15 May 2036, Alexandria palace. Lossenski lands with Russian air-ship Vindaya; Alan arrives in Ithuriel, seizes Vindaya; Alan's rapier kills a guard. Khalid demands; Alan shows Mediterranean islet destroyed. Khalid swears truce one year.

## CH XVII. An Unholy Alliance
- Olga arrives in Revenge with 20 air-ships; Olga charms Khalid. Vizier Musa al Ghazi drugged. Mecca flight. Olga offers to convert to Islam; alliance; Khalid vows war after truce.

## CH XVIII. A Momentous Commission
- Vindaya renamed Isma by Alexis. Council orders: fleet of 50 air-ships to Alexandria; ultimatum; Olga evacuates. Alan confronts; Olga arrives.

## CH XIX. Face to Face Again
- Olga arrives on palace roof; tears ultimatum; orders attack; Alan's rapier disarms her. Khalid intervenes. Olga falsely accuses Alan; Lossenski corroborates. Khalid sides with Olga; Alan's reply to Khalid. Olga's letter threatens war; Olga's squadron leaves.

## CH XX. The Call to Arms
- Fleets escort Russians out; Alan to London; King Albert II; Parliament weak; Alan takes control of Federation (May 27).

## CH XXI. The Home-Coming
- 11 May 2037 (Aeria, 133rd year of Peace). Return; Council Hall; Alan and Alexis reinvested with Golden Wings (temple of Natas urns; Richard Arnold/Natasha; Alan Tremayne/Muriel). Alma & Alan meet ("friends"). Isma kissed by Alexis.

## CH XXII. The Eve of Battle
- Reinvestiture ceremony; war to begin 16 May. Fleet divided; Alan West, Alexis East. Defence system; Aeria fortress. Farewells (Alma & Alan).

## CH XXIII. The First Blow
- 16 May 2037 at dawn: Avenger (Alan's ship) strikes Alexandria; then five Med expeditions destroyed by sub battleships (Ernstein's detector and magnet tactics). ~3 million die.

## CH XXIV. War at Its Worst
- Avenger over Moscow; scouts; Gibraltar; Alexis destroys Asiatic forces; Russian frontier battle; Odessa, Kieff, Vitebsk, Dünaburg, Riga bombed. Orders from Aeria: all Aerians to return (signed Alan Arnold, President, 16 May).

## CH XXV. A Message from Mars
- Vassilis Cosmo (astronomer; photo-telegraph with Mars) receives doom message: comet collision, Earth to pass fire-mist Sept 23 2037. Council; Alan refuses to be saved; Francis Tremayne (Vice-Pres, Alma's father). Natas's sealed prophecy read (describes 1920 star, Mount Austral caverns).

## CH XXVI. Sentence of Death
- Temple address; Council decides Alan, Alma, Isma exempt. Alan refuses; mother (unnamed, "Muriel"? no name given) urges return. Alexis oath.

## CH XXVII. Alma Speaks
- Palm grove by lake; Alma asks forgiveness; re-betrothal kiss; signal from Mars.

## CH XXVIII. The Sign in the Sky
- Council refuses air-ships for 2 months. Caverns sluice-gate plan. Fire-cloud signs. Communications end; Aeria isolated. 15 July comet visible.

## CH XXIX. The Truce of God
- 30 July gate tested. Weddings of Alan/Alma and Alexis/Isma (31 July). Avenger renamed Alma; Isma. Alexandria visit: Khalid receives; Olga arrives in Revenge with Khalid; Alma/Olga meeting; Olga shoots at Alma; Alan saves; Lossenski shot dead by Alan's bullet; Olga scarred across forehead.

## CH XXX. The Shadow of Death
- Musa and astronomer Hakem ben Amru confirm. Escape flights; world madness; human sacrifices; Aeria epidemic (painless deaths); selection of 250 Children of Deliverance; marriage 18 Sept.

## CH XXXI. The Last Battle
- Lake rises; 21 Dec? (15 Sept sluice down); Russian/Moslem fleet attacks; Alma & Isma join; battle at Ridge; last ships destroyed; Alan and Alexis close the door ~10pm.

## CH XXXII. The She-Wolf to Her Lair
- Olga & Khalid flee to Mount Terror in Revenge. Olga poisons crew; Boris (Lossenski's son? — Boris Lossenski) shoots Khalid through right lung; Olga kills Boris. Fire-cloud falls on Antarctica; they wait in council chamber.

## EPILOGUE. "Vengeance is Mine"
- Sluice lifted; atmosphere breathable; outer door jammed; tunnelled out. Aeria a swamp. Alan & Alma (and Alexis?) fly to Mount Terror. Olga alive, paralysed, insane; claims Alan dead; kisses corpse (Khalid's? body with black beard = Khalid, not Alan); dies on "dead" man. Alma: "God forgive her." THE END.
